messages:
maria: Huge shoutout to @facilities-team and @kevin for the last-minute cable rescue during the partner demo. projector went black and they sprinted with an adapter kit :running_man: :tada:
kevin: It was a scavenger hunt. found a mystery VGA->HDMI dongle in a drawer labeled 'probably works' and it actually worked. tech miracles. :pray:
ashley: also props to @jon for rerouting the staging traffic so we didn't blow past the demo rate cap. saved our necks. :sweat_smile:
jon: logged a tiny LB rollback and bumped the rate limit for the session. ops-bot prevented an auto-deploy while we were mid-demo which stopped a config flip. :robot_face:
ops-bot: Alert: auto-deploy blocked during active demo window. Canary held at stable.
facilities-team: Glad it went well! We'll put a dedicated "demo kit" bag in Meeting Room C with labelled cables, adapters, spare remote, and a mini checklist. Also leaving a post-it with emergency snack suggestions. :memo:
maria: idea: put a tiny laminated card with 3 steps (plug, restart, call facilities) so panicked presenters can follow. low-friction win. :white_check_mark:
kevin: and can we add a small stash of instant coffee to the kit? presenter adrenaline + no coffee = tragic. :coffee:
ashley: cupcakes on me tomorrow at 1pm? tiny celebration for the rescue team. sec, I'll DM you the flavors. :cupcake:
maria: yes please. team kudos thread for posterity — you all rock. felt like backstage heroes. :sparkles:
jon: agreed. also adding a short "demo runbook" to the docs repo so anyone can check the five things before going live. i'll drop a PR later today.
maria: perfect. thanks again everyone — saved the deck and the client's impression. :heart:
